heroHeadline: US-Mediated Russia-Ukraine Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi After Nine Months
heroSubtitle: Delegations led by Umerov and Medinsky met Nov 10 with Witkoff and Kushner mediating, focused on security guarantees. This follows a 317-drone overnight attack on Nov 8-9.
